Admission
Courses
Students with a Bachelor’s and/or Master’s degree in the biological sciences, chemical sciences, physical sciences may apply for postgraduate degree programs in the Division of Life Science (LIFS). Applicants should have obtained a Bachelor’s degree from a recognized institution with a grade average of 3 or above, or any equivalent qualification. Transcripts from an applicant’s previously-attended institution(s) and two letters of recommendation from academic referees are required.
Applicants whose first language is not English and whose degree or equivalent qualification was awarded by an institution where the medium of the instruction was not English are required to fulfill the minimum English language requirements of the University (i.e., TOEFL iBT: 80; IELTS: 6.5). For details, please refer to the Admission Requirements.
Application Deadlines
Admission timeline
Application Requirements
Application for admission is completed through our online application system. For fullest consideration, it is in your best interest to complete all parts of the application by or before the deadline. Incomplete applications may not be reviewed. A complete application should include:
Identity Document
Official Transcripts and Degree Certificates of Academic Qualification
Institution Grading System
Proof of English Proficiency
Academic References
For details, please refer to here.
Enquries
Additional information about the application process is available on the website of HKUST Fok Ying Tung Graduate School.
For admission-related enquiries from prospective students and current applicants, please send us a message.
For specific questions of an academic nature, contact lifspg@ust.hk.
